batches.name: batch-16
batches.prompt: Generate 4 variations of the SAME concept: a cinematic close-up of a person's hands holding a warm ceramic mug of spiced hot chocolate with cream beside a frosted windowpane, soft overcast winter light, cozy oversized ribbed knit sweater sleeves, subtle condensation on glass, realistic skin and fabric texture, premium seasonal lifestyle photography, calm intimate atmosphere, photorealistic. Keep the same hands, mug, window, and sweater in all 4 images; only vary framing and camera angle. No face, no text, no logos.
